compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: A regression test invokes brainstorm with BRAINSTORM_INTERACTIVE=false on a UI seed and asserts (a) ui_probes:deferred tag is present on the resulting epic and (b) the probe questions are not asked.
- DD5 (RED phase): Unit tests written (failing RED) for all new non-interactive path logic.

## Implementation Steps

1. Create `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh` (chmod +x) with:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
SKILL_MD="${REPO_ROOT}/plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md"
source "${REPO_ROOT}/tests/skills/lib/brainstorm-skill-aggregate.sh"
SKILL_MD=$(brainstorm_aggregate_path)
trap brainstorm_aggregate_cleanup EXIT

PASS=0; FAIL=0; SECTION="unknown"
pass() { echo "  PASS: $1"; PASS=$((PASS + 1)); }
fail() { echo "FAIL: ${SECTION}"; echo "  FAIL: $1"; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); }
```

   Sections to implement:

   **test_brainstorm_interactive_probe_skip** (DD1, DD4b):
   SECTION="test_brainstorm_interactive_probe_skip"
   grep -qiE 'BRAINSTORM_INTERACTIVE.*false.*skip|non.interactive.*skip.*probe|skip.*probe.*non.interactive|non.interactive.*path.*probe' "$SKILL_MD"

   **test_interactivity_deferred_emit** (DD2):
   SECTION="test_interactivity_deferred_emit"
   grep -q 'INTERACTIVITY_DEFERRED: UX probes require user input' "$SKILL_MD"

   **test_ui_probes_deferred_tag** (DD2):
   SECTION="test_ui_probes_deferred_tag"
   grep -q 'ui_probes:deferred' "$SKILL_MD"

   **test_loopback_bypass_noninteractive** (DD3):
   SECTION="test_loopback_bypass_noninteractive"
   grep -qiE 'non.interactive.*exception|non.interactive.*do not loop|BRAINSTORM_INTERACTIVE.*false.*loop|non.interactive.*UX.probe.*gap' "$SKILL_MD"

   **test_phase1_terminates_on_ux_probe_gap** (DD3):
   SECTION="test_phase1_terminates_on_ux_probe_gap"
   grep -qiE 'terminate.*gap.*deferred|terminat.*ui_probes|gap.*deferred.*ui_probes|non.interactive.*gap.*terminat|ui_probes:deferred.*gap|deferred.*tag.*terminat' "$SKILL_MD"

   End with standard Results block; exit 1 on any FAIL.

2. Append 5 RED markers inline to the existing `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md:` entry line in `.test-index` (do NOT add a new line with the same source key):
   ,tests/skills/test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh [test_brainstorm_interactive_probe_skip],tests/skills/test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh [test_interactivity_deferred_emit],tests/skills/test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh [test_ui_probes_deferred_tag],tests/skills/test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh [test_loopback_bypass_noninteractive],tests/skills/test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh [test_phase1_terminates_on_ux_probe_gap]

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given: SKILL.md corpus does not contain non-interactive probe-skip text, INTERACTIVITY_DEFERRED UX emission, ui_probes:deferred tag, or non-interactive loop-back exception
When: grep assertions run on the brainstorm SKILL corpus (via brainstorm_aggregate_path)
Then: all 5 sections fail with non-zero exit code (RED confirmed)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — RED test sections are gated by RED markers in .test-index
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh || true
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/skills/test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh
- [ ] All 5 test sections fail RED (before SKILL.md amendment)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-noninteractive-ux-probes.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo RED_CONFIRMED
- [ ] .test-index SKILL.md entry contains all 5 new RED markers (appended inline to existing line)
  Verify: grep 'plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md' .test-index | grep -q 'test_brainstorm_interactive_probe_skip'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
